# Privacy Policy	![][image1]

### 1\. Introduction

Welcome to Noble Forest RV Village (“we,” “our,” or “us”). This Privacy Policy is designed to inform you about how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website [nobleforestrv.com](http://nobleforestrv.com), interact with us via SMS, or use our services. By using our website and services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

### 2\. Information We Collect

###### *Personal Information:*

We collect personal information you provide to us directly, including but not limited to:

&nbsp;

Name

Email address

Phone number

Reservation details

Payment information

Vehicle license plate

###### *Usage Data:*

We automatically collect certain information about your visit to our website, such as:

&nbsp;

IP address

Browser type

Operating system

Referring URLs

Pages viewed and time spent on our site

&nbsp;

###### *Cookies and Tracking Technologies:*

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small data files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you use our website. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

&nbsp;

### 3\. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for various purposes, including:

&nbsp;

Processing and managing reservations

Communicating with you about your stay and providing customer support

Sending promotional materials and updates about our services (you can opt-out of marketing communications at any time)

Analyzing website usage to improve our site and services

Ensuring the security and integrity of our website and services

### 4\. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information with:

&nbsp;

Service providers who assist us in operating our website and services (e.g., payment processors)

Law enforcement or legal authorities if required by law

Business partners or affiliates for operational purposes, provided they adhere to similar privacy standards

&nbsp;

###### *Social Media Additions*

Our website includes social media integrations, such as the Facebook Like button, Instagram feed, or Share This button that run on our site. These features may collect your IP address, which page you are visiting on our sites, and may set a cookie to enable the feature to function properly. Social Media additions are either hosted by a third party or hosted directly on our website. This Privacy Policy does not apply to these features. Interactions with these features are governed by the privacy policy and other policies of the companies providing them.

&nbsp;

###### *External Websites*

Our website provides links to other websites on occasion. We do not control, and are not responsible for, the content or practices of these other websites. Our provision of such links does not constitute our endorsement of these other websites, their content, their owners, or their practices. This Privacy Policy does not apply to these other websites, which are subject to any privacy and other policies they may have.

&nbsp;

### 5\. SMS Communication

By providing your phone number, you consent to receive SMS messages from us regarding your reservations and other relevant information.&nbsp;

Guests may receive SMS prior/during/after their stay with us.

Reply STOP to Opt Out, or contact us directly at *info@nobleforestrv.com*. Standard message and data rates may apply.

### 6\. Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

### 7\. Your Rights and Choices

You have the right to:

&nbsp;

Access, correct, or delete your personal information

Opt out of receiving promotional communications

Limit the use of your information for certain purposes

To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details provided below.

&nbsp;

### 8\. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we are protecting your information.

### 9\. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
